items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: this was Lieutenant Policeman Brody--Charles Brody

ctx.x: What names in there do you recognize? Which ones can you recognize by name on that picture?

Well, there's Littleton McDuff. He was a lieutenant policeman here then. Do you know Leonard...uh, Littleton McDuff? He was the head of the captain...of the detectives he was in but he was ...liked music, you know, and he played. Now this boy here was...his name was Carter. He was with "Dr. Ferdon" [Medicine Show] for 20 years or more. He was the head of his show, and when he came home, we, between he and my brother and I, opened the music store, and after two years, he wanted to go back on the road, and we…
